sources.observation: The forecourt-facing screen has five tall arched bays divided by giant columns, a pediment, and rooftop figures that climb toward the central figure.
The north facade has two open arcades with five bays each, broad upper cornices, and two small slate spires above the bell openings.

limitations: The facades and bell towers are photographic reconstructions on the mapped footprint. Heights, smaller roof outlines and the individual roof sculptures are approximate.
